verdict.rationale: Unleash documents variants that expose different versions of a feature for A/B and multivariate testing, so it delivers multivariate flags beyond simple booleans. The pack never shows variants carrying typed values (strings, numbers, JSON), and one hands-on evaluator said Unleash 'lacks remote configuration', so the dynamic-configuration half of the story is unsupported. missing for 10: documented variant payloads with string/number/JSON types, evidence of serving dynamic configuration values through SDKs, independent corroboration of remote-config capability

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
